purpose_context: The for_review->in_review review-claim guard currently blocks legitimate cross-profile review because it compares the wrong identity (the implementer's stamp) on that edge. This mission makes the guard role-aware, sourced from the canonical event-log status seam (no split-brain), so distinct profiles can review each other's work while genuine reviewer collisions stay guarded and reviewer independence remains advisory.
purpose_tldr: Let a reviewer running a different agent profile claim and review another profile's work package, instead of being wrongly blocked as a self-review.
